title: Attention Head Function Taxonomy Validator: Testing Whether Published Head Type Classifications Are Stable

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If the existing head function taxonomy has poor coverage, safety analyses relying on it may miss important computation. Plausible but the chain from taxonomy coverage to concrete safety outcomes requires additional steps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing detection criteria for multiple named head types (induction, copy suppression, backup name mover, etc.), each with its own activation pattern definition. Beginners would need deep familiarity with the mechanistic interpretability literature and TransformerLens. Significant mentor dependency.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple head types, two models, classification plus characterization of unclassifiable heads. The project has many moving parts and the characterization of unknown head types is open-ended.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
